div.head: VII Atr 3.2
div.ab: Et in omni cenobio et conuentu monachorum celebret omnis presbiter singulatim XXX missas pro rege et omni populo, et omnis monacus XXX psalteria.
Et in omni cenobio et conventu monachorum celebret omnis presbiter singulatim xxx missas pro rege et omni populo, et omnis monacus xxx psalteria.
Et in omni coenobio et conventu monachorum celebret omnis presbyter singulatim xxx missas pro rege et omni populo, et omnis monachus xxx psalteria.
And in every foundation and college of monks every priest severally shall celebrate 30 masses for the king and the whole nation, and every monk shall repeat [the psalms from] his psalter 30 times.
And in every monastery or community of monks, every priest is to individually celebrate thirty Masses for the king and for all the people, and every monk to chant his psalter thirty times.
Und in jedem Stifte und Mönchskloster feiere jeder Priester dreissig Messen besonders für den König und das ganze Volk, und jeder Mönch [singe] dreissig Psalter.
And in every minster and monastery let every priest celebrate thirty masses individually for the king and all the people, and every monk [sing] thirty psalters.
